notes: About: 'KILLSTAR is a dark n' edgy lifestyle cult'; 'over-sized prints, studded leather and digital designs'; "'Total Trash Occult Couture' – est MMX" (2010). Homepage meta: 'Clothing & Lifestyle company with a twist of darkness'.

Operator: privacy policy names Draco Distribution, Inc. ('operator of Killstar ... headquartered in the United States'), Draco Distribution LTD and GmbH; terms say 'Draco Distribution Ltd (t/a KILLSTAR)'. The brand's own country isn't stated plainly, so hq_country is null.

Delivery page: 'Free Shipping On Orders Over $175' (physical goods only); 'KILLSTAR fulfil orders from a global hub in the EU'; US economy 'delivered in 7-14 business days'. Canada and the UK are not on the US store's list (other Killstar stores serve them), so only US stored.
Returns: '14 days from delivery to register your return, then another 14 days to send your items back'.
Tee descriptions: Boxy T-Shirts are '100% cotton jersey', 'Boxy fit', with artwork on the front and sleeves (e.g. Shadows With Eyes Boxy T-Shirt $60).
size_range detail: 8 of 9 men's tees XS–4XL; Blind Mind T-Shirt S–XXL.
